sources.note: Main product page for Procentive on Ensora Health. Describes it as behavioral health EHR with scheduling, documentation, billing, reporting. Notes 28,000+ practices and 200,000+ providers across the Ensora portfolio.

ONC compliance/mandatory disclosures page. Lists certified criteria, describes single-patient and population-level EHI export, references FHIR endpoints at fhir.procentive.com, notes integrations with eRx, Inpriva, Dynamic Health IT.
Procentive FHIR server landing page. Running Dynamic FHIR Server 4.0.1 / ConnectEHR v4 + BulkFHIR4. Lists practice endpoints but doesn't enumerate specific FHIR resources on landing page.

Ensora Health knowledge base for Procentive. Lists modules: Appointments & Clients, Clinical Documentation, Payments, Billing, Bed Management, ePrescribe & Eligibility, Fax/Message/Ticket Chat, Reporting & Service Times, Staff Management. Describes it as 'Complete behavioral health EHR'.
Press release about bed management module launch (2022). Describes bed tracking, capacity visibility, waitlists, integration with billing/scheduling. Confirms Ensora serves 30,000+ therapy practices.

Case study: NUWAY Alliance (Minneapolis nonprofit substance use recovery, founded 1996). Uses Procentive for intake through discharge, bed management, e-prescribing with EPCS, state reporting, billing. Generates ~3,400 reports daily. Custom DSM-5-ready reports.

Third-party listing. Describes pricing from $20/feature/month, lists features including scheduling, billing, clinical charting, reporting (120+ templates), client portal, telehealth. Targets behavioral health, mental health, substance abuse, chemical health, rehabilitation.

Third-party listing. Describes as 'integrated EHR and practice management for mental health, behavioral health, and substance abuse providers.' Lists scheduling, billing, workflow engine, clinical EHR, reporting, client portal, telehealth. Integrations: DrFirst, Sisense, thera-LINK.

Competitor comparison article. Lists Procentive features: clinical notes, intake/discharge, RCM, CRM, secure messaging, telehealth, ePrescribing, patient portal, billing with denials/appeals, scheduling. Notes staff-to-staff messaging appears limited. Serves substance use, mental health, ABA, PT/OT/SLP.

Article on therapy tech company ownership (April 2023). Confirms Therapy Brands operates Procentive, TheraNest, Fusion, WebABA, MyClientsPlus, Catalyst, AccuPoint, TenEleven. KKR majority stake since 2021.

History of Therapy Brands: founded 2013 in Birmingham by Shegun Otulana, started with TheraNest. KKR acquired majority stake for $1.2B in May 2021. Acquired Echo Group Nov 2022. Procentive listed among brands but acquisition date not specified.
Success stories page. Only one Procentive case study listed (NUWAY Alliance). Rest are for other Ensora products.
